findings.title: Node refusal occurs after queuing every sibling
findings.defect: boundLossless checks ++nodes only after pop, but Object.values(...)/push schedules every child first. A wide within32MiB decoded array can allocate millions of additional worklist objects before the100000-node refusal. This is extra traversal allocation beyond the explicitly accepted decoder allocation risk.
findings.smallestCorrection: Enforce node/depth budget while scheduling/discovering children and iterate child values lazily, without allocating a complete siblings array/worklist before refusal. Preserve exact depth16/node100000 accepted boundary and JsonNumberLiteral atomic treatment. Add exact-at-limit/one-over regression alongside current depth/atomic controls.

findings.title: Occupied-port witness comment overstates attempted-bind visibility
findings.defect: Success while an intended port is occupied excludes acquisition of that configured listener; it alone does not observe every attempted bind. Source forbidden-call instrumentation is the distinct no-attempt witness.
findings.smallestCorrection: Clarify comment to distinguish successful configured-port acquisition from source-level no-attempt instrumentation. No workload/deadline/predicate changes.
